name: QAGOMA free entry and student concession for exhibitions
provider: Queensland Art Gallery | Gallery of Modern Art
summary: Free entry to QAGOMA in Brisbane, with concession prices for full-time tertiary and TAFE students at ticketed exhibitions.
key: Entry to the Gallery is free; some exhibitions, cinema screenings and events need a paid ticket.
who: Full-time Australian tertiary and TAFE students.
Full-time international students with an ISIC card and their institution card.
how: Show your concession card at the exhibition entry.
catches: Concession prices are listed on each exhibition page, not here.

evidence.quote: Entry to the Gallery is free, some exhibitions, cinema screenings and events may require a paid or booked ticket.
Full Time Australian Tertiary and TAFE Students
Individual patrons must show concession cards at the exhibition entry to receive concession ticket price.
